responsibility: Provides the generated documentation URL mapping for Visium target options. This auxiliary option-metadata file pairs each option declared in visium.opt, such as mcpu, mtune, floating-point mode, simulator/debug switches, and privilege-mode selections, with the corresponding anchor in the GCC manual’s Visium options page, so GCC’s generated option help and diagnostics infrastructure can attach stable manual links to Visium-specific command-line switches.
